dashboard.introTitle: Natural Village Machine Learning Analysis System
dashboard.introText: is a linguistic analysis platform based on 283,070 natural village names in Guangdong Province. The system applies machine learning and natural language processing techniques to analyze village name semantics, structure, spatial distribution, and other features from multiple dimensions, providing data support for toponymy research, cultural geography, linguistics, and related fields.

search.title: Village Search
search.description: Search villages by keyword and region, view detailed information and in-depth analysis reports
search.tooltip: Supports fuzzy keyword matching and three-level administrative division (City → County → Township) cascading filters. Click a village to view in-depth analysis reports covering semantic structure, N-gram decomposition, spatial features, and more.

character.title: Character Frequency
character.description: Analyze character usage frequency, regional tendencies, semantic embedding vectors, and statistical significance in village names
character.tooltip: Statistical analysis of characters across 283,070 village names. Includes: ① Frequency tendency (Z-score/Lift/Log-odds metrics for regional preference) ② Embedding similarity (Word2Vec Skipgram, 100-dim vectors, cosine similarity) ③ Character network (Louvain community detection) ④ Significance (Chi-square test, Cramér's V effect size)

semantic.title: Semantic Analysis
semantic.description: Explore semantic categories, label combination patterns, semantic network relationships, and semantic composition structures of village names
semantic.tooltip: Based on hybrid lexicon v4.0 (LLM-annotated + manually verified), 9 major categories + 76 subcategories. Includes: ① VTF (Virtual Term Frequency, confidence-weighted) ② Bigram/Trigram combination patterns (PMI mutual information) ③ Semantic network (NetworkX graph analysis) ④ Semantic indices (Shannon entropy, diversity metrics)

spatial.title: Spatial Analysis
spatial.description: Visualize the geographic distribution of villages, identify spatial hotspot clusters, and analyze spatial integration patterns
spatial.tooltip: Uses DBSCAN density clustering (eps radius + min_samples) to identify geographic hotspots. Supports spatial autocorrelation analysis, cluster centroid calculation, and MapLibre GPU-accelerated rendering. Adjustable eps parameter (0.5-20km) to explore spatial patterns at different scales.

pattern.title: Pattern Analysis
pattern.description: Extract N-gram patterns, analyze structural regularities, and discover linguistic features in village naming
pattern.tooltip: Extracts 2-4 gram character sequence patterns. Statistical metrics: ① PMI (Pointwise Mutual Information, log₂[P(A,B)/(P(A)·P(B))]) ② Chi-square significance test ③ Lift tendency (regional frequency / global frequency ratio). Supports wildcard search (* for any character, X for single character).

regional.title: Regional Analysis
regional.description: Compute regional aggregate statistics, generate regional feature vectors, and perform cross-regional comparative analysis
regional.tooltip: Aggregates by City/County/Township levels. Generates TF-IDF feature vectors (TF=regional frequency, IDF=log(total regions / regions containing feature)). Computes cosine similarity / Jaccard similarity between regions to identify toponymic cultural areas. Supports Z-score tendency heatmap visualization.

compute.title: ML Compute
compute.description: Execute machine learning clustering analysis, extract high-dimensional feature vectors, and perform in-depth subset analysis
compute.tooltip: Login required. Supports three clustering algorithms: ① K-Means (centroid-based, requires k value) ② DBSCAN (density-based, auto-detects noise) ③ GMM (Gaussian Mixture Model, probabilistic assignment). Feature engineering: semantic (9-dim) + morphological (N-gram TF) + diversity (Shannon entropy) + spatial (coordinates + density). Preprocessing: StandardScaler + PCA (default 50 components). Evaluation metrics: Silhouette Score ([-1,1]), Davies-Bouldin Index (lower is better), Calinski-Harabasz Score (higher is better).

villages.label: Total Villages

characters.label: Unique Characters
characters.tooltip: 3,067 unique Chinese characters used in place names. Word2Vec embedding vectors trained for each character (dim=100, window=5, min frequency=5).

ngrams.label: Significant N-grams
ngrams.tooltip: Statistically significant N-gram patterns filtered by PMI (Pointwise Mutual Information) and Chi-square test.
